race.description: Taree Cup Calcutta @ The Railway Taree Mdn Hcp
race.comment: COLUMBO (7) resumes. Took ground off the progressive Proxima Dea when fourth over 1400m at Randwick ten weeks ago. Fitter for the two searching trials and the blinkers go on. Hard to stop. MAGATAMA (15) Maurice mare with her hoof on the till. Appreciated the extra ground with a tidy fourth over 1280m at Muswellbrook. Should keep improving as she gets out in trip. Top three contender. TALK ABOUT LAYLA (6) failed to come up in the one run last prep. Trialling well with the two solid performances and the scratchings help her chances. PIOLLA (11) closed strongly on debut at the big odds when fourth over 1212m at Coffs Harbour. Smyth sticks and the claim keeps her in the picture.
